posts.title: Surgical Dramaturgy: The Most Important Tool Is the Cut
posts.excerpt: Two Greek words stand at the door of this essay, and they have been arguing for two and a half thousand years. Surgery comes from kheirourgia: kheir, the hand, and ergon, work. Hand-work.

posts.title: Cut The Bullshit.
posts.excerpt: Let’s be clear — we use AI. Text, images, video. All of it. And we’re not against shortcuts. Here’s the thing: a shortcut only works if you know where you’re going.
